extra_reads.requirement: Actual route availability and attributable nonempty data or exact reviewed native boundary/composite; meter metadata/frame, transport authority/state, cursor availability and log effects stay interpreted business semantics. capture_meter_cursor_controls.requirement: Accepted exact bound control and paired cleanup. File save requires exact nonempty changed artifact; cursor controls require returned snapped time matched by available user getter. transport_controls.requirement: Exact owned object/transport association and lifetime; state/scoped action relations where observed. Prepare and media-mode retain acknowledged result-only boundaries; no acoustic/restart/global restoration claim.

log_controls.requirement: Exact bound channel/message/severity, once-only authorized execution; complete multiplicity/removal or matching event effect where observable; exact older Console native observation boundary retains schema-only acknowledgement, never inferred effect or native absence.

console_loaded_media.requirement: Separate exact Console availability/business support or explicitly approved representative/composite, actual observed host/build disclosed, complete current array replay; Authoring support does not automatically qualify and no Console nonempty execution claim is authorized.
